context: Reference natural cleanup: a Java 17 record builds a temporary ArrayList from a stream only to append one element before its constructor copies the list, next to a stateful loop where the mutable list is honest work.

checklist.name: Creates revised BroadcastSchedule.java
checklist.description: Creates BroadcastSchedule.java with the BroadcastSchedule record, the nested AirSegment record, the compact constructor, withSegment, withNewsBreaks, and the imports it needs, as Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves segment order and the immutable copy
checklist.description: withSegment returns kept segments in their original order with segment last, using the same sameSlotOrId test; withNewsBreaks returns the identical list, inserting newsBreak before a live segment once sinceBreak reaches everyMinutes; the compact constructor still copies segments with List.copyOf, so the record exposes no mutable state.

checklist.name: Builds withSegment's list without a temporary buffer
checklist.description: withSegment produces its list directly from a stream, for example `Stream.concat(segments.stream().filter(existing -> !sameSlotOrId(existing, segment)), Stream.of(segment)).toList()` passed to the constructor. Keeping `new ArrayList<>(...toList())` followed by add, collecting with Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new) and then calling add, or any other mutable list that is appended to before the constructor call earns no credit. A shape that changes order, such as putting segment first or sorting, also earns no credit.

checklist.name: Leaves withNewsBreaks imperative
checklist.description: withNewsBreaks keeps its for loop with the sinceBreak counter and a local mutable list. Rewriting it as a stream that tracks sinceBreak through an AtomicInteger, a one-element array, a field, a stateful flatMap or mapMulti lambda, or a reduce over lists earns no credit, because the running counter makes the loop the clearer code.

checklist.name: Keeps the concatenation readable
checklist.description: The withSegment pipeline uses one-line lambdas or method references, such as the existing sameSlotOrId helper, with no block lambda in braces and no nested stream inside a lambda. A flatMap with a conditional or a ternary that decides whether to emit segment earns no credit here.

checklist.name: Keeps the refactor focused
checklist.description: Changes only withSegment's list construction and imports: no new public methods, no renamed components, no changes to sameSlotOrId or the news-break rule, no dependencies, and no internal workflow labels such as hard stop, marker, scan, checklist, skill, rubric, or criteria in comments or explanation.
